_readme: One basic-share count per company per distinct CEBE as_of. scripts/update.mjs appends a row when as_of is new and replaces the row when the same as_of comes back with a different count. It does not append a duplicate every run. Δ Shares is the latest row's basic_shares minus the row before it. % Δ Shares is that change divided by the previous count. Seed sources are filing citations; do not invent a count.
